Want someone to remember you after just one conversation? Use these 3 tricks. Because most people are forgotten in five minutes. First, use their name once. Not ten times, once. Say it naturally when you agree with something they said. A person's own name is the sweetest sound to their brain.

Second, ask the second question. Don't just ask, what do you do? Ask, why did you choose that? That's where real conversations start. Third, leave first. End the conversation while it's still fun, with a smile. People remember the moment that ended too soon. Follow for more.
